description: Review-first, local-only file organization with explicit safety gates.

defaultPrompt: Help me safely clean up my desktop and free up disk space
Help me clean up this messy folder and find duplicates
Help me find large files taking up disk space
interface.longDescription: TidyGuardian inventories one explicitly selected local folder, creates frozen plans and offline review receipts, and supports only same-filesystem moves, reversible quarantine or restore after separate live confirmation. Permanent deletion, quarantine purge, directory removal, Windows mutation, cross-filesystem fallback, telemetry, uploads, background services and automatic installers are disabled.

name: tidyguardian
